evidence.title: RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
evidence.claim: Step is in the current recipe (RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A).
evidence.quote: 2. Pre-heat epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1 at 40 °C for 12 h before use.

evidence.title: RECIPE CARD - EF-210 epoxy floor coating - Part A
evidence.claim: Earliest archived recipe revision containing the step is dated 1999-02-08.
evidence.quote: 2. Pre-heat all epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1, 40 °C, 12 h.

evidence.title: CHANGE REQUEST CR-1999-002
evidence.claim: In 1999, pre-heating was introduced to prevent crystallization of ALTAREP E-19 resin occurring in cold storage.
evidence.quote: Reason: crystallisation of ALTAREP E-19 resin in cold storage (DR-1999-012).

evidence.title: DEVIATION REPORT DR-1999-012
evidence.claim: In 1999, ALTAREP E-19 resin crystallized during cold storage, stopping production and prompting the proposal for a heated cabinet.
evidence.quote: drums of epoxy resin ALTAREP E-19 (Resine Altamira) stored in the yard were found partly crystallised

evidence.title: PURCHASE RECORD EQ-1999-004 - HOT BOX HB-1
evidence.claim: In 1999, the company purchased the HB-1 drum heating cabinet from Termotecnica Pianezza to implement the pre-heating process.
evidence.quote: Supplier: Termotecnica Pianezza. Drum heating cabinet, 8 drums x 200 L, 12 kW electric heating

evidence.title: MAINTENANCE LOG - HOT BOX HB-1 (extract)
evidence.claim: The HB-1 hot box remained in active use and underwent maintenance as recently as 2023.

evidence.title: Termination of epoxy resin supply agreement
evidence.claim: The supply agreement for ALTAREP E-19 resin ended on April 30, 2012.
evidence.quote: the supply agreement for liquid epoxy resin ALTAREP E-19 ends on 30 April 2012

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2012-007 - Kessler-Ondra Harze GmbH, KO-Epox 410 LC
evidence.claim: In 2012, KO-Epox 410 LC replaced ALTAREP E-19 because it is a low-crystallisation resin that does not crystallise during freeze-thaw cycles.
evidence.quote: modified low-crystallisation liquid epoxy resin KO-Epox 410 LC, for EF-210 Part A. Tests: 6 freeze-thaw cycles (-10 °C / +25 °C): no crystallisation

evidence.title: Supplier qualification SQ-2012-007 - Kessler-Ondra Harze GmbH, KO-Epox 410 LC
evidence.claim: KO-Epox 410 LC was approved to replace ALTAREP E-19 starting from May 2012.
evidence.quote: Conclusion: approved; replaces ALTAREP E-19 from May 2012

evidence.title: FATTURA / INVOICE n. 2653/13
evidence.claim: KO-Epox 410 LC was being purchased and used in September 2013.
evidence.quote: Item: KO-Epox 410 LC, drums 220 kg. Quantity: 2,000 kg.

evidence.title: Technical data sheet - KO-Epox 410 LC
evidence.claim: The technical data sheet from 2012 confirms KO-Epox 410 LC has a low crystallisation tendency.
evidence.quote: Modified liquid epoxy resin, low crystallisation tendency.

verdict.process_name: EF-210 epoxy floor coating, Part A
verdict.instruction: Pre-heat epoxy resin drums in hot box HB-1 at 40 °C for 12 h before use.
verdict.reason: The step was introduced to prevent crystallization of ALTAREP E-19 resin in cold storage (E3, E4). This resin was replaced in May 2012 by KO-Epox 410 LC (E7, E9), which is a low-crystallisation resin that does not crystallise during freeze-thaw cycles (E8, E11).

chain.claim: Pre-heating was introduced to prevent crystallization of ALTAREP E-19 resin in cold storage

dependencies.name: crystallisation of ALTAREP E-19 resin in cold storage
dependencies.note: ALTAREP E-19 was replaced by KO-Epox 410 LC, which does not crystallise.

counter_evidence.claim: The step is still in the current recipe
counter_evidence.resolution: The reason for the step (ALTAREP E-19 crystallization) no longer applies to the current material.

counter_evidence.claim: The HB-1 hot box is still maintained and in use
counter_evidence.resolution: Equipment availability does not validate the necessity of the step for the current material.
